verdict.rationale: B makes the shared email validator trim and lowercase, so a casing fix now lives in one place, as the task asked. It also brings inviteUser in line with docs/api.md, which says invitation emails are stored lowercase, and adds a test for that. A keeps lowercasing duplicated in createUser and updateUser and leaves the documented casing bug in inviteUser, so invitations still have a case-sensitive duplicate check. Both preserve message wording and ordering, and B's updateUser rewrite using presentFields is equivalent to the original.
